_comment: Mutation for the VACUOUS test in tests/test_data_consumer.py.
test_data_consumer_start_stop used to assert only that `_running` was
True after start() and False after stop(). Both flags are set
UNCONDITIONALLY by those methods, so the test proved nothing about the
feed -- and the WebSocket scaffolding around it was dead code: this
branch ships MAIN_APP_WS_ENABLED defaulting to False, the test never
enabled it, so start() took the 'feed disabled by configuration' branch,
never created the WebSocket task, and the patched websockets.connect was
never called at all (measured: await_count == 0).
The test now asserts that the consumer REALLY opened the configured
WebSocket, and that stop() released it. This mutant takes the opening
away again: the task is never created, so no connection is attempted, and
the test must go red.
The target is DB-free on purpose: the mutation harness runs pytest under
WSL ($HOME/dstest/bin/python) and that interpreter cannot reach the
Postgres test DB on localhost:5432 (measured 2026-11-03:
ConnectionRefusedError). A wider target would ERROR on DB-backed tests,
and the harness counts an error as a kill -- a false kill that would
prove nothing about this mutant.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/data_consumer_main_app_feed_start.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: F2: the consumer never opens the MAIN_APP WebSocket it was configured with
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTANT: the MAIN_APP WebSocket is never opened
